boundary.description: From the point where Wigan – Salford District boundary crosses the railway, E along the railway, then S along the footpath going past Manor Farm and Bartonmoss Farm, crossing M62 Motorway, continuing in a straight line to the SW border of Boysnope Park Golf Club. Along that border and by a bee-line to Manchester Ship Canal. SE along the canal to the point opposite Fairhills Road, W along Fairhills Road, Roscoe Road, Astley Road to the Wigan – Salford District boundary. Then E and N along that boundary to the point it meets the railway.
